plugins.name: Amazon Without Sponsored
plugins.description: Hides sponsored products and ad banners from Amazon's search results and product pages, so you see what matches your search.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: AMP to Original
plugins.description: When a link opens a Google AMP copy of an article, goes to the publisher's own page instead, which is complete and isn't served through Google.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Back to Top
plugins.description: A small round button appears at the bottom right when you've scrolled far down a page, and takes you back to the top.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Copy as Markdown
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧C to copy the selected text as Markdown, with its links, headings, lists, bold, italics and code. Without a selection, it copies the page's title and address as a Markdown link.

plugins.name: Other Sites in New Tabs
plugins.description: Links that lead to a different site open in a new tab, so the page you were reading stays where it was.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: GitHub Wide
plugins.description: Lets GitHub use the whole window for code, diffs, issues and pull requests, instead of a narrow column in the middle.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Google, Just Results
plugins.description: Removes sponsored results and ads from Google Search, so the first links are real results.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Hide Comments
plugins.description: Hides comment sections on YouTube, news sites, blogs and Reddit, for a quieter read. Turn it off for a moment from Tacet Plugins when you want to read them.

plugins.name: Keyboard Navigation
plugins.description: Browse without the mouse: press F to label every link, then type its letters to open it (⇧F opens it in a new tab). J and K scroll, G goes to the top and ⇧G to the bottom. Keys do nothing while you type in a field. Sites with their own single-key shortcuts, like YouTube and Gmail, keep theirs.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Old Reddit
plugins.description: Opens Reddit in its classic layout at old.reddit.com: lighter, faster and with more posts on screen. Galleries, chat and settings still open in the new design.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Picture in Picture
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧P to float the video you're watching in its own small window, on any site, even ones that hide the button.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Reading Progress
plugins.description: On articles, a thin bar at the top shows how far you've read, and a small label says how many minutes are left.

plugins.name: Stack Overflow, Clean
plugins.description: Hides Stack Overflow's sidebars, hot questions, ads and sign-up prompts, and widens the question and answers.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Video Speed
plugins.description: Change the speed of any video with ] and [ (in steps of 0.25×), and press \ to go back to normal. A small label shows the speed.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Word Count
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧W to see how many words and characters are in the text you selected, or in the whole page, and how long it takes to read.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: X Without Distractions
plugins.description: On X (Twitter), hides trends, "Who to follow", premium offers and the sidebar's suggestions, leaving your timeline and replies.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: YouTube Focus
plugins.description: Hides YouTube's home feed, the recommended videos next to the one you're watching and the suggestions at its end, so you watch what you came for. Search and subscriptions stay.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: YouTube without Shorts
plugins.description: Hides Shorts from YouTube's home page, search, subscriptions and sidebar, and opens any Shorts link as a normal video.
